response.original_title: The Fantasticar: State of the Art
response.overview: This short provides notes from Tim Story, concept artist Tim Flattery, TransFX project manager Charlie Zurian, TransFX Fantasticar project manager Mark Demlin, TransFX designer engineers Akiel and Phil, and actors Ioan Gruffudd and Michael Chiklis on the looks at the design and creation of the Fantasticar.
